title: 第7章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 那枚戒指“啪”顾启一巴掌重重的拍在桌子上，站起来威胁的开口，“堂堂南华市总裁，被父亲登报断绝父子关系，你要是丢得起这个人，我就不逼你结婚”这是绝对不能爆出的丑闻，他还真丢不起这个人。顾墨眼眸眯起，看着顾启略带得意的样子，深吸了一口气，看来这次爸是铁了心的。男人三十一枝花，他就不知道爸是怎么想的，好像他过了三十岁就娶不到老婆一样，年迈三十就天天下催命符。顾墨倔强的开口，“要我结婚是吧，那好，明天我去买个老婆回来，听说越南老婆便宜又听话”“胡闹，买什么越南老婆，给我找本地媳妇”顾启瞪了他一眼。看来这一次爸是准备赶鸭子上架了，顾墨有些烦躁，现在他只想好好工作，压根就没做好准备结婚，而且看着架势，估计他跟那姑娘还没看对眼，就要被押着他去结婚了。顾墨还试图说服顾启，“爸，我真不想结婚，再多给我两年时间吧，我保证三十五岁之前给你找个媳妇”“三十五岁？”顾启的音量立刻飙高，“你老子我还不知道能不能再活五年呢，你想我死都死都死不瞑目是吧”顾墨心里憋着闷气，还不想就这么屈服。毕竟是自己的儿子，顾启那里不知道他的想法，他重新坐在沙发上，“儿子啊，你要是不自己选，你爸就给你包办婚姻了，到时候找一个瘸腿瞎眼的，不合你意的，可不是我面对一辈子，到时候受折磨的还不是你”连瘸腿瞎眼的都要，爸真的想媳妇想疯了。顾墨头也不回的往门口走去，这顿饭他是吃不下去了，他是答应说找了，找不找得到，那就只有鬼知道了。顾启自然知道他是屈服了，心里暗自高兴了一阵子。吕青燕从厨房出来，就看见儿子走了，连忙追上去，“顾墨，怎么走了呢？”“让他走让他走”顾启不在乎，脸上乐呵不已，总算把这小子搞定了，老细胞都死了好多，今晚必须多吃两块肉补一补。“你们又不欢而散了啊”吕青燕皱眉，连忙询问。顾启得意洋洋的开口，“混小子答应了，不过我知道他不过是表面上答应，私下底才不用心呢，我们还得要趁胜追击，一举拿下”儿子是他生的，那他就有办法治他。吕青燕刚高兴又愁上了，“那怎么办？”“经过我的观察，有一个女孩我还蛮喜欢的，留学生，气质出众，我已经跟对方的父母沟通了一下，明天直接带人杀去他的地方”姜还是老的辣。吕青燕冲他竖起了大拇指。顾启喝了一口茶，眉宇间还有一丝忧愁，“哼，我知道顾墨心里还念着那个女人，但是那个女人已经拒绝他的求婚了，而且都这么久了，顾墨还没谈女朋友的意思，再继续下去还得了，我不能让那女人耽误我儿子一辈子”“是啊，也不知道是怎么回事，恋爱谈得好好的，我也以为她能成为我们顾家的媳妇，想不到最后还是分手了，还伤了顾墨”顾启哼了一声，“我们顾家的人怎么可以被人甩了还苦苦等着，必须结婚，让那女人看看，顾墨和她分手了，可以过得更好”酒吧里，顾墨点了一瓶酒，一个人坐在包间里，闷闷的喝着酒。其实平日里，顾墨不是爱酒之人，只有在极度烦躁的时候，他才会喝酒。呵，结婚，这个词语曾经离自己好近，几乎触手可及。他放松身体靠在沙发上，眼里的苦涩一闪而过。从口袋里摸出一枚戒指，闪亮亮的，十分的精致，是枚女士戒指，尽管过去三年了，但是他还是随身携带着。越看越郁闷，他点烟了一支烟，狠狠的吸了一口，然后将戒指扔进了酒杯里，顿时，酒液弥漫过了戒指。要是当初她同意了，那么现在他们的孩子都快要上幼稚园了吧，那儿还用天天被逼婚啊。他从小到大，不管做什么事情都顺风顺水，几乎只要想要的，都能得到，连周围的朋友都说他太幸运了。但是最后他却被甩了，而且是在求婚的当场，呵呵，现在想起来，心还觉得疼痛。新娘不是她，跟谁结婚对他来说都没差别，俯身把戒指捞出来，回到办公室，拿出一小盒子，把戒指放进去，盖上盖子。三年了，他或许真的该放下了。其实这些年父母不停的逼婚，跟这件事也是有关系的，他们的担心他不是不知道，但是感情要是真那么容易割舍就好了。罢了，父母年纪也大了，还是不要再让他们为自己担心了，如果结婚他们能快乐和放心的话，那么他就结婚吧。而且就算他这一辈子不结婚，她跟自己也不可能还有机会在一起。…..“绵绵啊，你不知道，只从你把向思怡削了之后，一下子就在公司红起来了，好多男同胞都向我打听你呢，这不，下班之后有人请我们去唱K，去呗”司绵无精打采的趴在桌子上，“不去”“为什么？你不是最喜欢唱K了吗？一进KTV就拿着话筒不放手”“那是以前”夏日凑过去，看见她像霜打了一样，不由的担心，“你怎么了？你哥又欺负你了啊”“怎么可能”她在家里乖得就跟只小白兔一样，苏颂想欺负她，都逮不到机会。
content_en: The ring "popped" Gu Qi slapped the table hard, stood up and said threateningly, "The dignified president of Nanhua City was published in the newspaper by his father to sever the relationship between father and son. If you can afford to embarrass this person, I will not force you to get married." This is a scandal that must not be exposed. He really cannot afford to embarrass this person. Gu Mo narrowed his eyes, looked at Gu Qi's slightly proud look, and took a deep breath. It seemed that his father was determined this time. If a man has thirty-one flowers, he doesn't know what his father thinks. It's like he won't be able to marry a wife after he is thirty years old, and when he is thirty, he will have a life-threatening talisman all over the world. Gu Mo said stubbornly, "You want me to get married, okay? I'll buy a wife tomorrow. I heard that Vietnamese wives are cheap and obedient." "Nonsense, why are you buying a Vietnamese wife? Find me a local wife." Gu Qi glared at him. It seems that this time Dad is ready to rush the ducks. Gu Mo is a little irritated. Now he just wants to work hard and is not ready to get married at all. And looking at the posture, it is estimated that he and the girl have not yet seen eye to eye, and they will be escorted to get married. Gu Mo also tried to persuade Gu Qi, "Dad, I really don't want to get married. Give me two more years. I promise to find you a wife before I'm thirty-five." "Thirty-five?" Gu Qi's voice immediately soared, "I don't know if I can live for another five years. You want me to die with my eyes open, right?" Gu Mo was sulking in his heart, not wanting to give in just yet. After all, he is his son. Gu Qi didn't know what he was thinking. He sat on the sofa again and said, "Son, if you don't choose by yourself, your father will arrange a marriage for you. Then you will find someone who is lame and blind. If you don't like it, I won't face it for the rest of my life. You won't be the one who will be tortured by then." Even if he wants a lame and blind person, his father really wants his wife crazy. Gu Mo walked towards the door without looking back. He couldn't finish the meal. He promised to find it, but only the devil knows whether he can find it or not. Gu Qi naturally knew that he had given in, and was secretly happy for a while. When Lu Qingyan came out of the kitchen, she saw her son leaving and hurriedly chased after him, "Gu Mo, why are you leaving?" "Let him go, let him go." Gu Qi didn't care, his face was full of joy. He finally got rid of this kid. Many of his old cells had died. He had to eat two more pieces of meat tonight to replenish his body. "You broke up on bad terms again?" Lu Qingyan frowned and asked quickly. Gu Qi said proudly, "The bastard agreed, but I know he only agreed on the surface and didn't care about it privately. We still have to take advantage of the victory to pursue it and win it in one fell swoop." If his son was born to him, then he would have a way to cure him. Lu Qingyan was just happy but then worried, "What should I do?" "After my observation, there is a girl I quite like. She is an international student and has an outstanding temperament. I have already communicated with her parents and will directly take someone to her place tomorrow." Jiang is still old and spicy. Lu Qingyan gave him a thumbs up. Gu Qi took a sip of tea, with a trace of sadness on his brows, "Humph, I know that Gu Mo still misses that woman in his heart, but that woman has already rejected his proposal, and it's been so long. Gu Mo still doesn't want to have a girlfriend. It's okay to continue. I can't let that woman delay my son for the rest of his life." "Yeah, I don't know what's going on. Love is going well. Yes, I thought she could become our Gu family's wife, but I didn't expect that they broke up in the end and hurt Gu Mo." Gu Qi snorted, "How can we, the Gu family, wait so long after being dumped? We must get married and let that woman see that Gu Mo can live a better life if he breaks up with her." In the bar, Gu Mo ordered a bottle of wine and sat alone in a private room, drinking wine gloomily. In fact, Gu Mo is not a drinker on weekdays. He only drinks when he is extremely irritable. Oh, marriage, this word was once so close to me, almost within reach. He relaxed and leaned on the sofa, the bitterness in his eyes flashed. He took out a ring from his pocket. It was shiny and very delicate. It was a women's ring. Although it had been three years, he still carried it with him. The more he looked, the more depressed he became. He lit a cigarette, took a long drag, and then threw the ring into the wine glass. Immediately, the wine filled the ring. If she had agreed at the beginning, their children would be almost in kindergarten now, where they would still be forced to get married every day. Ever since he was a child, he has always been successful no matter what he does. He can get almost anything he wants. Even his friends around him say he is so lucky. But in the end, he was dumped, and it was on the spot where he proposed. Haha, thinking about it now, my heart still hurts. The bride is not her, and it doesn't matter who she marries to. He leaned over and fished out the ring. He returned to the office, took out a small box, put the ring in and closed the lid. It's been three years, maybe he really should let it go. In fact, the fact that his parents have been forcing marriage over the years has something to do with this matter. It's not that he doesn't know their worries, but it would be nice if feelings were really so easy to let go. Forget it, his parents are getting older, so he should not let them worry about him anymore. If they can be happy and relieved by getting married, then he should get married. And even if he never gets married in this life, she and she will never have the chance to be together. ..... "Mianmian, you don't know, you became famous in the company just after you cut off Xiang Siyi. Many male compatriots asked me about you. No, someone invited us to sing K after get off work. Let's go." Si Mian lay on the table listlessly, "No." "Why?" "Don't you like to sing karaoke the most?" "That was before" Xia Tian walked over and saw her as if she was beaten, and couldn't help but worry, "What's wrong with you? Your brother bullied you again" "How is that possible?" She was as good as a little white rabbit at home, Su
